archiveTitle: Evening Brief | Earth Defense Force 6.2 Announced

entries.headline: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Announced: PS5 Exclusive, 2027 Release
entries.summary: D3 Publisher and SANDLOT have announced Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD. This is not a simple port but a PS5-focused enhanced version of Earth Defense Force 6: peak enemy counts roughly double the original, over half of existing missions reworked, plus new weapon customization, new missions, and unknown enemies. The game launches in Japan in 2027, with a playable demo at Tokyo Game Show 2026.
entries.verification: Opened D3 Publisher's specific product page, confirming platform, 2027 window, enhanced version positioning, enemy counts, mission reworks, weapon customization, and TGS demo. Denfami Nico Gamer independently reported at 12:00 the same day, cross-confirming details.
entries.timeNote: D3 official site dated August 25, 2026; Denfami Nico Gamer's independent report precisely marked 12:00 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Ylem's Cat Announced: Girl and Shapeshifting Cat Team Up
entries.summary: Chinese studio Diamond Cat has revealed the single-player action-adventure game Ylem's Cat. Players control Molly, a girl searching for her missing mother, who teams up with a shapeshifting cat named Mio to battle and explore a dying planet. The Steam page is live, confirming Simplified Chinese support; only a PC version is announced, with no release date yet.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Steam product page, confirming developer/publisher, gameplay overview, PC platform, Simplified Chinese support, and undated status. Gematsu's bylined report provides precise timing and cross-confirms the announcement.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu original time is August 25, 00:47 EDT, converted to 12:47 Beijing time; Steam product page was live and accessible within the window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam Simplified Chinese store banner for Ylem's Cat, featuring girl Molly and cat Mio together

entries.headline: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER Opening Movie and Theme Song Revealed
entries.summary: Arc System Works, Drecom, and SuperNiche have unveiled the opening movie for DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER. The theme song 'Dropout' is written and composed by syudou, with arrangement by Rockwell. The game is a strategy RPG centered on sacrificing your own units for advantage, targeting PS5, Switch, and PC, releasing October 22.
entries.verification: Opened Arc System Works' official video and Steam product page, confirming the opening movie, developer/publisher, and release info. Gematsu's bylined report cross-confirms theme song credits and precise timing.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu original time is August 24, 23:43 EDT, converted to August 25, 11:43 Beijing time; official video released in the same window.
